description: PCSX2 log signatures. Strings verified against PCSX2 v2.8.2 source (VMManager.cpp, ps2/BiosTools.cpp, GS/GS.cpp, GS/Renderers/DX12).

rules.title: PlayStation 2 BIOS not found
patterns: Unable to auto locate a BIOS image
rules.probableCause: No valid PS2 BIOS is in the BIOS folder PCSX2 is configured to use.
manual: Dump the BIOS from your own PlayStation 2 and add it in Settings > BIOS & Firmware.
OmniDeck cannot download BIOS files for legal reasons.

rules.title: PCSX2 is configured with a BIOS that no longer exists
rules.probableCause: The BIOS file was moved or renamed after PCSX2 was configured.

rules.title: PCSX2 could not open the game file
rules.probableCause: The game file is missing, unreadable, on a disconnected drive, or not a valid disc image.
manual: Check that the drive holding the game is connected.
Re-dump or re-copy the game if the file is damaged.

rules.title: PCSX2's graphics renderer failed to start
rules.probableCause: The selected renderer is not supported by your GPU or driver.

rules.title: Direct3D 12 is not usable on this system
patterns: D3D12: Agility SDK configuration is not available
rules.probableCause: PCSX2's Direct3D 12 renderer failed to initialise on this GPU/driver.

rules.title: PCSX2 failed to initialise the controller
rules.probableCause: The controller configuration in PCSX2.ini is invalid.

rules.title: PCSX2 could not start audio
rules.probableCause: No working audio output device, or the configured audio backend is unavailable.
manual: Check that a playback device is enabled in Windows Sound settings.

rules.title: PCSX2 could not read part of the BIOS
patterns: BIOS Warning: .* could not be read
rules.probableCause: The BIOS file or its companion files are locked or have restrictive permissions.
manual: Make sure the BIOS files are not read-protected or open in another program.
